title: The Tiffin Room
draft: Built 2026-10-18 from the 4.3 'Base Chain' stub's B2 with its defaults ('take the defaults and build 4.3b'): Kumar trapped in his auto on the road west (save it with a thrown tumbler → he drives for you; walk on → his line ends), the Indiranagar café 'Rameshwara Tiffin Room' (parody, ADR-47) with Uncle as base 2 (days 4–7), the office return (ADR-44: colleagues infected at the shuttle bay, Prakash among them; the AMR-07 log from the server room — your parser's columns, read by Deepa), Raju's rescue at the Whitefield darshini, the generator running dry on its third night → Cubbon (B3, next phase).
time: Act 4 day 4 06:10 → the morning of day 7
player_goal: Get your people to Uncle's tiffin room, and do what the city asks of you from there.
design_goal: The second base and the first real choices of the chain: two rescues paid for in items (a tumbler for Kumar, stones for Raju) or refused, and the first proof that the outbreak was known — in your own parser's output. The café is a lit island in a fallen district; the run goes back to Whitefield, where Acts 0–2 happened, now emptied by the curfew.

cast.role: KUMAR, the airport's Kannada auto driver, named at last: trapped in his auto, three of them leaning on it. A tumbler down the side lane frees him; he drives you to the café and on the runs.
NEW. Uncle, sixties, forty-one years behind the counter: a generator with three nights of diesel, steel tumblers, a shutter that comes down. Sends you to Raju.
Asks for the AMR-07 log from your office's server room; reads it: 14 March, 02:10 — the alarms switched off, the parser still logging.
Raju (the Whitefield darshini, Act 0–1) shut in his own kitchen, two of them at his counter; stones on a van draw them off.
By the shutter; Cubbon after the dark night.

beats.what: First light: the walk west (a card) to Indiranagar; Kumar's horn — two short, one long. Throw a tumbler down the side lane (they turn, the auto comes) or keep walking. Either way, the tiffin room (a card).

The tiffin room: Uncle, the generator ('three nights'), Raju's call on the landline before it died. The café is the base: the mats are the bed, the counter the shelf, a table the bench, the kitchen searched.

Day 5: the run to Whitefield (a card: Kumar's back roads, or the railway line on foot) — the ITPL gate open, the colleagues standing at the shuttle bay (Prakash's spectacles); the server room behind the lobby: the AMR-07 log.
Prashanth Layout: Raju through the darshini's back window, two at his counter. Stones on a van up the road, or 'I can't, Raju.' Home at dusk (a card).
Deepa reads the log: 14 March, 02:10, the readings flat, the alarms off — 'That's your parser.'
The third night the generator dies (a card); Uncle: the army's lamps at Cubbon. (Pack.)

assets_needed: the tiffin room (generated interior, first try)
acceptance: the bot plays it from the hill to Uncle's decision
